summary: Frontend-only verification of the new pronunciation-correction layer (src/lib/pronunciation.js) and its integration into src/lib/audio.js speakHanzi(). All requested checks passed: pronunciation module transforms strings correctly (24/24 Back-Shū 俞→腧 conversions, 4/4 word-level overrides, 3/3 pass-through cases). UI verification via Playwright with a stubbed zh-CN voice + intercepted SpeechSynthesisUtterance/speak confirmed 25 audio buttons across BL/LV/REN/SJ/LU meridians emit the corrected Hanzi to the TTS engine at rate=0.55, lang=zh-CN, single utterance, with the FakeMandarin voice selected via pickMandarinVoice. On-screen Hanzi and Pinyin remain the original values (肺俞/Fèi Shū, 攒竹/Cuán Zhú, 膻中/Dàn Zhōng, 行间/Xíng Jiān, 浮郄/Fú Xì, 消泺/Xiāo Luò). Search 'LU7' returns '1 hasil'. Scroll-to-top works on navigation. yarn build compiles successfully. Regression sweep: only src/lib/audio.js was modified and src/lib/pronunciation.js was added; meridians.js, PointCard.jsx, AudioButton.jsx, SiteHeader.jsx, MeridianDetailPage.jsx, HomePage.jsx are untouched.
critical_code_review_comments: pronunciation.js is well-documented and small; ordering (WORD_OVERRIDES first, then CHAR_OVERRIDES per char) is correct so 俞府 → 腧府 works without a whole-word entry.
applyPronunciation() is called BEFORE the \p{Script=Han} filter in speakHanzi(), which correctly benefits both point and meridian audio, as spec required.
Locked audio config preserved: single SpeechSynthesisUtterance, utter.rate=0.55, pitch=1, volume=1, cancel() before speak, synchronous speak() within click, primeVoices/cachedVoices flow untouched.

Minor (non-blocking): CHAR_OVERRIDES uses 腧 (shù) for 俞 — spec uses 'shū' Pinyin; both readings are commonly accepted for TCM Shū points, and 腧 is deliberately mono-reading. Documented in comments, acceptable.
context_for_next_testing_agent: To assert the transformed text sent to TTS in a headless browser (which has no native zh-CN voice), stub window.speechSynthesis.getVoices to prepend a fake { name:'FakeMandarin', lang:'zh-CN', localService:true, default:true } voice, replace SpeechSynthesisUtterance with a plain-object factory (real utterance rejects non-native voice objects), and override speak/cancel to capture calls into window.__spoken. That pattern is proven and reusable — see iteration_5 Playwright script.
rca of the issue: N/A — feature verification, no bug found.
